title: structural-coupling
description: The property of an aperiodic-autopoiesis-cell that environmental perturbations are interpreted through the cell's own internal nuclei. The cell is perturbed by histories t' ≠ t but does not directly inherit external structure: the perturbation reshapes (σ_t', Δ_t') via fiberwise variation, and the cell's content at t' is what the new internal nuclei produce, not what the environment directly imposes.
